interpretation: pilot reference-agreement; independently verified annotations reported separately
normalization: NFKC, casefold, collapsed whitespace, canonical apostrophes; Unicode alphanumeric words with internal apostrophes; retain diacritics, numbers and repetitions; no stemming or stopword removal
uncertainty: Explicit [?], [illegible], [unreadable] and [unclear] markers consume tokens and never match, including marker versus marker
empty_story_reference: wordless agreement subgroup; agreed_wordless/disputed_wordless; failed and unrun retained in intended denominator; no token F1
empty_nonstory_reference: not_annotated because importer deliberately blanked these pages
failed_text_prediction: zero recovered content in intended denominator
unrun_text_prediction: zero recovered content in intended denominator and incomplete run flag
ocr_matching_unit: photographed page or spread, never adjacent-page pooling
ordered_secondary_metrics: CER retains normalized punctuation; WER uses normalized tokens; insertions may exceed 1.0
character_matching: book-local one-to-one exact normalized variant overlap; one leading article/possessive determiner stripped symmetrically; ambiguous assignments report conservative/optimistic bounds
incomplete_credits: known-credit recall; no strict set accuracy or precision against incomplete author/illustrator lists
themes: not_annotated; never score default false values
sampling: stratified inverse-probability population estimates; challenges reported separately
excluded_metadata_only_titles: Things You Should Know about Bugs

C1.rule: Archive all book-authored lettering; analyse narrative, informational and in-scene illustration lettering separately from paratext.

C2.rule: Main narrative, informational and wordless narrative pages participate; bibliographic matter, decorative endpapers, glossary/index and supplemental activities do not.

C3.rule: Names and descriptive referring expressions are lexical aliases; pronouns, body parts and editorial labels are separately retained evidence.

C3_population.rule: Retain individuals, collectives, generic groups and discourse roles in separate strata with unresolved identity.

C4.rule: Keep photographed-edition imprint and publishing house distinct; preserve first-publication and edition events and source evidence.

C5.rule: Existing positives and consistency metrics support exploratory pilot-only claims; dev20 aliases-only recall has ten positives and is a smoke test.

C6.rule: Analytical authors include explicitly credited authors and retellers; retain all original contributor roles.

C7.rule: Also emit bare/short contiguous printed referring heads with full phrase and owner evidence; label embedded_short_form when no independent occurrence exists. Category words must be printed and refer in context. Collective occurrences stay with the collective; membership alone never attaches them to an individual. Ambiguous heads retain alternative candidates.

alias_recall_interpretation: Dev20 6/10 equivalence-normalized aliases across five books is a smoke test; strict raw surface credit 4/10 is separate.
